understanding: The selected entry point constructs the repository's Paxos implementation with master-provided replica identity, peer addresses and initial leader flag. Observed responsibilities include per-instance prepare/accept processing, local commit marking, an independent ordered execution loop, recovery initiation, optional persistence helpers and client replies. This is a partial descriptive inventory, not a correctness assessment. The event dispatcher, proposal admission, ballot construction, broadcast selection, storage initialization and master failover loop remain unread. In particular, local COMMITTED status, an accept reply carrying a ballot, successful persistence and completed application are distinct assertions.
